nodes.label: Stale bash hash keeping the old binary after a fix is installed
nodes.norm_label: stale bash hash keeping the old binary after a fix is installed
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L04755] Patch still works right now (re-verified the full decrypt chain 30 seconds ago), so your shell is probably still running the **old** copy. Likely cause: bash hashed the path.

[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L04757] You ran `ani-cli` once before the fix existed, so your terminal remembers `ani-cli → /usr/bin/ani-cli` (5.1.0, broken) and keeps using it even though the fixed `/usr/local/bin/ani-cli` (5.1.5) now shadows it. My test shells are fresh, so they get the new one — that's why it works for me but not you.

nodes.label: Local grep wrapper routing to tgrep breaks one ani-cli call
nodes.norm_label: local grep wrapper routing to tgrep breaks one ani-cli call
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L05634] Fixed. Your `~/.local/bin/grep` wrapper was the culprit — it routes `grep <pattern> <file>` to tgrep (which prints those index warnings on a terminal). ani-cli has exactly one such call (history check, line 443); all its other greps use pipes and already bypass the wrapper.

[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L05636] I added a shell function in `~/.bashrc` that forces real GNU grep just for ani-cli (using the wrapper's own `GREP_WRAPPER=0` escape hatch, so your normal `grep` → tgrep speedup is untouched). Revert: delete that function.

rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L26026] 1. **Beda kepemilikan.** ani-cli itu upstream (diupdate via `yay`, sewaktu-waktu ketimpa). [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L26030] Struktur idealnya (`~/Proyek/ani-cli-indo/`, private):

[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L26734] - **Env**: kunci TIDAK ada di env. Sengaja — dia tinggal di file `~/.config/ani-cli-indo/subdl.key` (600), dan skrip baca file itu langsung. Lebih aman daripada env yang kebaca semua child process.
